installedPgBossPublicApi.applicationTransaction: PgBoss.send(name, data, options) accepts SendOptions; SendOptions extends ConnectionOptions and ConnectionOptions.db is IDatabase. node_modules/pg-boss/dist/types.d.ts defines IDatabase.executeSql(text: string, values?: unknown[]): Promise<{ rows: any[] }>. A checked-out pg PoolClient adapter can forward executeSql to that same client after BEGIN; call boss.send(queue, data, { db: adapter }), then COMMIT or ROLLBACK on the application connection.
installedPgBossPublicApi.nativeWorkerTransaction: PgBoss.work(name, { transactional: true, batchSize: 1 }, async (jobs, tx) => ...) is the public overload. TransactionalWorkHandler receives Job[] and tx: IDatabase; tx.executeSql writes share the pg-boss worker transaction and its completion. The built-in pooled Db supplies beginTransaction(), as documented by IDatabase in node_modules/pg-boss/dist/types.d.ts:31-36.
installedPgBossPublicApi.nativeLostClaimFence: node_modules/pg-boss/dist/manager.js:786-808 checks that completion still affected the claimed jobs; if an operator cancelled or failed a claim during handler work, pg-boss throws and rolls back the handler transaction before its ordinary failure path. Public cancel(name, id) is declared in dist/index.d.ts and its installed plan updates any job state before completed, including active.
installedPgBossPublicApi.ownership: Construct/start one PgBoss instance and let its native migration own schema pgboss (schema 44). Do not issue SQL against pg-boss tables, duplicate its migration, add a worker loop, or add a queue service. Use pg-boss public send/work/cancel/readback APIs and stop it in finally.

smallestFaultCases.setup: Send a job, register native work(..., { transactional: true }, handler), and write the domain marker only through the handler's tx.executeSql.
smallestFaultCases.fault: Throw a fixed handler error after the marker write; configure zero retries for this probe queue so settlement is terminal and deterministic.
smallestFaultCases.falsifier: Fail if the domain marker commits or the job is reported completed.

smallestFaultCases.setup: Hold a transactional worker handler at a promise barrier after tx.executeSql writes a marker. From a separate pg-boss pooled connection, call public cancel(queue, jobId) while the job is active, then release the handler.
smallestFaultCases.fault: The native completion sees that the active claim was lost.
smallestFaultCases.falsifier: Fail if the handler's domain marker survives; read back the cancelled job and absent marker after the worker transaction settles. Use barriers and bounded readback only; pg-boss remains the sole queue/worker implementation.
